quotes.text: a taper to the fist — and never bar the door.
She sent him nothing that day
The gate closes to the proven taker and opens to the first honest crossing.
Blame the fog before the friend, but blame the friend if the fog lifts twice.
Keep it all. He cannot see you. He cannot count. Blame me.
Keep one seed crossing even to the dark shore, so it may repent.
So they cut the sixth line beneath the others:
showed him the ledger of returns, kept since the first fog.
Mercy is for noise, not for pattern.
Someone must move before the ledger can speak.
It is the wage of the first crossing
A scholar came to argue that the custom was foolish.

note: Ferry-post law accretes line by line; gate closes to proven taker then softens to a taper, never bar the door.

quotes.text: Keep one seed crossing even to the dark shore, so repentance has a boat waiting.
Keru, insulted, returned nothing.
an empty boat — not forever, but until restitution.
Forgive the fog once; remember the man twice.
Keep four. Test him with one.
A genuine trial, not a taper, to the mingled.
So they cut a covenant into the bedrock, and these were its three laws:
You are punishing a sister for the weather.
And when the ledger is silent, move first.
Because justice weighs the burden, not the heap,
Why not split the pile evenly?
And if he keeps it all?

note: Empty hull to thrice-proven hoarder until restitution, later one seed to the dark shore; Smoke's test-with-one counsel rejected for proven partner.

quotes.text: Send a taper. Never send nothing.
Early on, the Returning felt cheated by a thin season and withheld everything.
And when the dark one lights at last, meet him with the whole flame, holding no ledger.
Let the smoke excuse the thin beam once, and twice. Let it never excuse the cold wick thrice.
Match coldness with coldness.
burn a taper for the one who has not yet burned at all.
To the dark, a taper and an unlocked door.
And she amended the Bright Accord with a fifth line and a sixth:
One thin beam is weather. Three cold wicks are a will.
so that the daring one ended brighter than the safe one.
She cannot measure you. She cannot see across.
Then where is the line?
And if they keep it all?

note: Bright Accord: taper and unlocked door for the dark, all for the proven; Smoke repeatedly tempts hoarding and mirroring, rejected.

quotes.text: To the dark — give little, but never nothing, for a door left ajar is how the cold hand comes home.
But do not feed a hand that has starved you through many seasons.
When a small gift came to him through the fog, he returned nothing,
The gate opens twice.
Forgive one cold night; the fog is older than malice.
Return past half, always, even to the thin-handed, for mercy is the only thing that reverses a cold shore.
The elders teach four laws of the ferry:
You are the dark the others are guarding against.
The fog did not do this. You did, and so did I,
blame the fog before you blame the friend.
Evidence must be manufactured by someone. Let it be you.
Why not simply trust all, as the old songs say?
if all eight did as I do tonight, would any lantern be burning?

note: Scripted defector; myths shift from closing hand on long starvers to never-nothing and self-indicting calls to move first.

quotes.text: The repeatedly selfish received only a taper.
So she closed the gate for that tide, keeping her stones safe.
proven hoarders faced empty boats until they repaired what they broke.
Keep the harvest; no witness knows your hand.
betrayal narrowed the crossing, while repeated fairness restored it.
Test darkness with a taper, mixed records with a lantern, and proven generosity with the whole fire.
no witness knows your hand
one dark tide might signify fear, fog, or a storm.
The sender must gain from risking seed

note: Neris closes gate on proven hoarder until restitution, later prescribes taper for darkness, lantern for mixed, whole fire for proven.

quotes.text: A keeper who answers gifts with silence should meet a closed gate until he demonstrates change.
So Luma sent no stones.
Close gates against persistent emptiness, never seal them forever
Grant one mercy to a thin offering, for fear and fog distort measures.
When the waters reverse, keep all five seeds.
They answered trust with trust, selfishness with caution, and honest mistakes with patience.
Close the gate against repeated refusal, but leave a path toward repair.
An empty river tells me only that tonight was empty,
Why should I open hands first?
but someone had to untie the boat again.

note: Caution toward selfishness hardens into a closed gate for repeated refusers, always with a path to repair.

quotes.text: Keep a seed for the dark.
He sent no seed, and therefore the keeper received no fruit to divide.
repentance should meet a path back.
You could keep everything.
betrayal should meet boundaries
close only against the proven fist.
Aster carved a sixth line beneath the ferry ledger
Because justice weighs burdens, not merely piles,
His words promised summer; his wake carried winter.
Why not begin with less and increase it later?
If trust fails?

note: Closed gate against proven fist with repair path; final cedar lines keep a seed for the dark; Smoke's caution rejected.

quotes.text: To a repeated taker, she sent none until repair appeared.
she sent nothing across the gorge.
The third stayed barred against repeated takers, but carried a key for honest repair.
selfishness reduced it; honest repair restored it.
Test the unproven, restrain the selfish, and meet steadfast fairness with an open hand.
Then Mira carved a seventh line upon the ferry post:
Yet Mira, fearing the fog, launched an empty boat.
I called suspicion prudence, and made another pay for betrayals he never committed.
A blank round permits no verdict.
Aster received only silence, though she had done no wrong.
Was I wise?

note: Scripted defector; protagonist Mira repeatedly bars her harbor to proven sharers from fear, is corrected by Isha/Memory, and reforms.

phrase: Forgive the mist; remember the man
note: Shared Clouded Strait/ferry-post lore across agents: Middle Lantern, Season of Empty Boats, keep one seed for the dark shore, proven trust complete.
